items.exampleEn: The pictures on the wall are slightly out of alignment.
items.exampleZh: 牆上那幾幅畫稍微沒有對齊。

items.exampleEn: The seeds sprouted after a week of rain.
items.exampleZh: 下了一個星期的雨之後，種子發芽了。

items.exampleEn: There was a flicker of light in the window of the empty house.
items.exampleZh: 那間空屋的窗戶裡閃過一道微弱的光。

items.exampleEn: Someone hacked into my email account last night.
items.exampleZh: 昨晚有人駭進了我的電子郵件帳號。

items.exampleEn: Volunteers dispensed hot soup to the runners at the finish line.
items.exampleZh: 志工們在終點線把熱湯分發給跑者。

items.exampleEn: Tourists and local people mingle in the busy market.
items.exampleZh: 觀光客和當地人在熱鬧的市場裡打成一片。

items.exampleEn: Strong winds churned the sea into white waves.
items.exampleZh: 強風把海面攪動成一片白浪。

items.exampleEn: Her eyes slowly grew accustomed to the dark.
items.exampleZh: 她的眼睛慢慢習慣了黑暗。

items.sentenceEn: The machine in the lobby dispenses hot and cold drinks.
items.sentenceZh: 大廳裡的那台機器提供冷熱飲料。

items.audioEn: At the party, Ken mingled with the guests instead of staying in the kitchen.
items.audioZh: 派對上，Ken 和賓客們交流，而不是一直待在廚房裡。
items.questionZh: Ken 在派對上做了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: My stomach was churning before the job interview.
items.sentenceZh: 工作面試前，我的胃一直在翻攪。

items.sentenceEn: Green shoots are sprouting all over the garden.
items.sentenceZh: 花園裡到處都冒出了綠色的嫩芽。

items.stemEn: If your car pulls to one side, check the ____ of the wheels.
items.stemZh: 如果你的車會偏向一邊，就檢查一下輪胎的定位。

items.stemEn: After a month in Taipei, she became ____ to the humid weather.
items.stemZh: 在台北住了一個月後，她習慣了潮濕的天氣。

items.passageEn: When our neighbors started a garden on an empty piece of land behind the station, few people believed in it. The ground was hard, and volunteers had to hack through thick weeds before they could plant anything. Then, in early spring, the first seeds sprouted, and a flicker of hope appeared. Today the garden is principally run by about twenty volunteers, and it has become a place where people from different backgrounds mingle. On weekends, families bring food to share, and children who were once accustomed to playing indoors now spend hours outside.
items.passageZh: 當我們的鄰居在車站後面的一塊空地上開闢菜園時，沒什麼人看好。地面很硬，志工得先砍除茂密的雜草，才能種下任何東西。後來到了初春，第一批種子發芽了，大家也看到了一絲希望。如今菜園主要由大約二十位志工經營，成了不同背景的人交流的地方。週末時，家家戶戶帶食物來分享，以前習慣待在室內玩的孩子們，現在會在戶外待上好幾個小時。

questions.questionZh: 志工種東西之前得先做什麼？
options: 先向車站借用這塊空地

questions.questionZh: 現在週末會有什麼情景？
options: 一家家帶食物來和大家分享

items.promptZh: 我還不習慣這麼早起床。
referenceEn: I am not yet accustomed to getting up so early.
I'm still not accustomed to waking up this early.
rubricZh: be accustomed to 後接名詞或動名詞（例如 accustomed to getting up 等）
「還不」可寫，例如 not yet、still not 等
「起床」可寫，例如 get up、wake up 等

items.instructionZh: 用 mingle 造一個句子，說說你在聚會或活動中和別人交流的情形。
referenceEn: At the wedding, I mingled with guests I had never met before.
I usually mingle with my colleagues at the company dinner.
rubricZh: mingle with＋人表示「（在社交場合）和⋯交流、打成一片」（例如 mingled with the guests 等）
時態配合內容（例如 mingled、mingle 等）
